functions.name: Observe
functions.obligation: must not silently mutate canonical field state

functions.name: Relate
functions.obligation: relation type and evidence basis must be explicit

functions.name: Filter
functions.obligation: removed possibilities must be provably irrelevant/impossible for the declared goal

functions.name: Transform
functions.obligation: preserve declared invariants or record exact loss

functions.name: Project
functions.obligation: record eliminated coordinates and induced relations

functions.name: Branch
functions.obligation: children must cover the parent obligation exactly

functions.name: Verify
functions.obligation: verifier must be independent of heuristic steering where practical

functions.name: Repair
functions.obligation: repair must be exact/evidence-qualified and trigger global re-normalization

functions.name: Learn
functions.obligation: learn only consequences valid in the parent field

functions.name: Reconstruct
functions.obligation: destructive reductions require a reconstruction/lift map

functions.name: Terminate
functions.obligation: result must satisfy goal or carry a certified impossibility/unresolved disposition
